crossChapterBoundaries: PD psychosis and RBD are treated here; detailed Lewy-body dementia and the one-year convention belong to the next cognitive-disorders chapter.
Cerebellar localization is limited to movement/ataxia decisions; a full neurological examination was covered in Chapter 1.
Acute ataxia questions address syndrome recognition and posterior-fossa deterioration rather than repeating the complete stroke reperfusion algorithm.
Wilson disease coverage emphasizes neurological recognition and treatment hazards; hepatology will address liver-specific decisions.
requiredFinalReview: Check criterion versions and exact diagnostic thresholds against original consensus documents.
Verify medication doses, interactions and current regulatory indications, distinguishing US/UK examples from local availability.
Confirm current repeat-expansion and ataxia therapeutic evidence, including limits of exome sequencing.
Review every question for one defensible best answer and closely competing distractors.
Install only the completed validated chapter; record source-access and independent-review limits.
